timing_reference_conditions: 25 C; IF 5 mA, IL 100 mA, VL 10 V for timing. Values are not a qualified delay at the actual small probe load/24 V field load.
limits: Presence is an ordinary machine permissive; shorted PhotoMOS output or welded/bridged presence contact can mask a release.
NC float loop detects opens, not a shorted cable/contact or shorted receiver; it is not safety-rated overtravel detection.
Parked head must remain assembled and wired for router mode; its float is not a router touchplate. Router Z zero is manual in this design.
PCB, creepage/clearance, enclosure, physical harness/strain relief, supply transients, actual temperature/delay and EMI are not qualified.
Field C is already fused by F_CONTROL; this head interface does not qualify that fuse or provide semiconductor short-circuit protection.
Each relay coil must remain <=40 mA over actual voltage and coil temperature. Total HEAD_SAFE load <=150 mA. Retain coil-local flyback protection.
No actual plasma torch, raw arc or cutter trigger is connected to this circuit.
